title: StudentPortfolioDraft
description: Strict four-field AI response shape for the fictional-only static demo. Local generationMode labels are not provider fields. Runtime validation also checks supplied-student IDs, inline [EVIDENCE-ID] references and same-domain citation ownership; educator review must still establish factual support.

domains.description: Every domain with supplied evidence must cite its own domain evidence inline as [EVIDENCE-ID]. Unsupported domains must state the evidence gap rather than invent observations.

nextSteps.description: Provisional educator-confirmed suggestions, not assertions of observed outcomes. Any factual claims need inline citations.

evidenceIds.description: Unique supplied evidence IDs for the selected student; every inline citation must also appear here.
